reviewed_cause.cause: Forward column-flex item flow was classified as unbreakable visual overflow; principal box ownership, atomic balancing minima, padding and actual final source end were lost during distribution.
reviewed_cause.correction: Use separate containing-box and item source extents in shared measurement and continuation distribution; retain the first indivisible unit and materialize ordinary leaf item slices.
